kaikki_vikisozluk.e: مُرَّاكُش or مَرَّاكُش • (murrākuš or marrākuš) f
kaikki_vikisozluk.t:
Uncertain. Possibly from a Zenaga, or a Zenaga-like form related to Tashelhit rks (“to be hidden, to hide”).
The popular etymology from ⴰⵎⵓⵔ ⵏ ⴰⴽⵓⵛ (amur n akuc, literally “Land of God”) likely reflects folk etymology, since neither ⴰⵎⵓⵔ (amur) nor ⴰⴽⵓⵛ (akuc) are attested in Berber languages of the area.
s: Tashelhit rks (“to be hidden, to hide”)
g: Marrakech (the capital city of the Marrakesh-Safi region, Morocco)
